versions.content: function GetCurrentKeyValueStorageSize [SWS_PER_00405] Upstream: RS_PER_00017 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00137 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < std::uint64_t > GetCurrentKeyValueStorageSize (const ara::core::InstanceSpecifier &kvs) noexcept; Returns the space in bytes currently occupied by a Key-Value Storage. The returned size includes all metadata and the space used for redundancy and backups. The returned size is only guaranteed to be accurate if the Key-Value Storage is not opened and no other operation on the Key-Value Storage takes place at the same time.
